title.zh: 腾讯 Hy4：正式版与开放权重
title.en: Tencent Hy4: Production Release and Open Weights

evidence.quote: Tencent today announced the release of Tencent Hy4, its latest-generation large language model, marking a significant leap in performance and capabilities that now ranks it among the world’s leading open-source AI models.
The new model also introduces visual understanding capabilities for the first time, alongside major improvements in instruction following, long-context comprehension and long-horizon agentic tasks
The language backbone comprises 770B total parameters, of which 49B are activated per token.
We open-source Hy4, Hy4-FP8, and the pre-trained Hy4 base model weights on Hugging Face, ModelScope, and GitCode.
Hy4 is released under the Tencent Hy License.

notes.zh:
问题：Hy4 正式版是什么定位，参数量能不能直接引用，权重和 system card 是否已经放出。
证据位置：腾讯官方发布页写明 Hy4 于 2026-11-04 发布，首次引入视觉理解，并在指令跟随、长上下文理解与长程 agent 任务上有提升。Hugging Face 官方模型卡写明语言主干 770B 总参、每 token 激活 49B（视觉另计 1.23B），上下文 1M；并明确 Hy4、Hy4-FP8 与 Hy4 base 权重已在 Hugging Face、ModelScope、GitCode 开放，system card 同时提供。发布页所说「随后发布权重与 system card」已于 2026-11-20 兑现。
作者自陈局限：发布页没有披露训练数据与算力；benchmark 图表与排名为厂商口径，部分为内部评测；许可为 Tencent Hy License，非 OSI 标准许可，商用前需读原文。
它没主张的：不是独立第三方评测第一；不是所有任务都适合 770B 规模；开放权重不等于无限制商用。
notes.en:
Problem: how is production Hy4 positioned, can its parameter count be quoted directly, and have the weights and system card shipped?
Where the evidence sits: Tencent's release says Hy4 launched on 2026-11-04, adds visual understanding for the first time and improves instruction following, long-context comprehension and long-horizon agentic tasks. The official Hugging Face model card states a 770B-parameter language backbone with 49B activated per token (plus 1.23B vision), a 1M context, and confirms that Hy4, Hy4-FP8 and Hy4 base weights are open on Hugging Face, ModelScope and GitCode with a system card. The launch-page promise that weights and system cards would follow was kept on 2026-11-20.
What the authors say about limits: the release does not disclose training data or compute; benchmark charts and rankings are vendor-reported and some are internal; the licence is the Tencent Hy License, not an OSI-standard licence, so read the text before commercial use.
What it does not claim: first place in independent third-party evaluation; that every task suits 770B scale; that open weights mean unrestricted commercial use.

specs.规模 / scale: 770B 总参 / 49B 激活（HF 模型卡）
specs.视觉 / vision: 首次引入视觉理解；视觉激活 1.23B
specs.能力重点 / focus: 指令跟随、长上下文、长程 agent
specs.证据位置 / evidence: 腾讯发布页；HF 模型卡 Model Summary 与 License
specs.复现状态 / reproduction: 未复现（只读官方发布页与模型卡）
